sections.text: US 10-year 5.00% (-11 bp in a month), 2-year 4.69% (-16 bp); 2s10s curve +31 bp (+5 bp in a month). Yields are little changed on the month. T-bill yield 4.03% sets the cost of carrying inventory.

sections.title: Dollar & farm currencies
sections.text: Dollar index 101.75 (+0.6% in a month, +3.5% YTD). USD/BRL 4.996 (-3.3% in a month): a firmer real slows Brazilian farmer selling and supports world prices. USD/CNY 6.670 (-0.6%); USD/MXN 18.65 (+6.3%); a sharply weaker peso cuts Mexico's buying power for US corn, pork, dairy and wheat (Mexico is the top buyer of all four).

sections.title: Risk appetite
sections.text: S&P 500 -1.1% in a month (+11.4% YTD); VIX 19.4. Neutral risk backdrop.

sections.title: Energy
sections.text: WTI 103.27 $/bbl (+15.4% in a month), Brent 111.70, ULSD 4.787 $/gal (+6.0%), natural gas 3.05 (-12.7%). Higher crude lifts biofuel margins (soybean oil, corn for ethanol) and synthetic-fibre costs (supports cotton), but raises diesel, drying and freight costs. Natural gas drives nitrogen fertilizer costs for next year's corn.

sections.title: China & industrial demand
sections.text: Copper -3.6% in a month, Shanghai Composite -6.3%, Hang Seng -7.0%, yuan +0.6% vs USD. Soft China/industrial signals point to weaker import demand.

us_econ: Inflation: CPI 3.7% y/y (2026-09), core 2.6%; core 3-month annualized 3.4%; core PCE 3.0%. Jobs: payrolls +29k in 2026-09 (3-month average +51k), unemployment 4.2% (+0.1), wages 3.0% y/y. Growth: real GDP 2.2% annualized in 2026-Q2, consumer spending 3.8%. Policy: fed funds target 3.75-4.0% (effective 3.88%); 2-year Treasury 4.69% (+0.81 vs fed funds: market pricing hikes); 10-year breakeven inflation 2.34%, real 10-year 2.66%. Farm prices (PPI farm products) +1.5% y/y; food-at-home CPI +1.8% y/y. For ags: high real yields and a firm dollar weigh on fund demand for commodities; sticky inflation keeps rates high (carry and storage costs up); a weak job market or falling real incomes hits meat and dairy demand first.
